result.question: Why can't Laish people be rescued?

readings.answer: Because the city was far from Sidon and had no alliance with anyone.
readings.support: because the city was far from Sidon and had no alliance with anyone

readings.answer: Because there was no one to deliver them.

assessments.reason: The verse explicitly says the reason was "because the city was far from Sidon and had no alliance with anyone," which matches the key.

"There was no one to deliver them" is stated in the text and directly answers why they couldn’t be rescued, though it is a less specific cause than the key’s detailed reasons (far from Sidon, no allies).
